lines.text: I have some news. I started a new job at the flower shop last week.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: That's good news! How was your first week there?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: It was busy, but my coworkers helped me a lot. I learned to make small gifts.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: That sounds fun. What kind of gifts did you make?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Small bags with flowers and a card inside. People buy them for birthdays.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Nice. My sister has a birthday next week. Is the shop open on Sunday?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, from ten until four. I will be there in the morning.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Great, I might come by before lunch and see what you make.
lines.speaker: Eli
